# Civilizational Unity

> Public knowledge resource for the scholarship of historian Abdullah al-Ahsan.

## Primary entity
- Abdullah al-Ahsan — historian of civilizations
- Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q24946801
- VIAF: https://viaf.org/viaf/33537331

## Author-approved site formulation
Civilizations are born and progress when they recognize and practice human dignity, and they decline and fall when they stop.

## Recurring categories
Professor al-Ahsan groups the recurring line of argument into four categories: Governance, Dignity, Cooperation, Flourishing. They are categories of the published record, not stages of a causal sequence.

## Provenance rule
Direct quotations and biographical claims should be traced to Professor al-Ahsan’s supplied wording/CV or linked publication, institutional, review, or authority records. Reading routes, thematic groupings, talk summaries, and teaching prompts may be editorial synthesis and are labeled where useful.

This file is a navigation convenience for systems that choose to use it. It is not a special ranking or AI-inclusion mechanism.
